usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and OpenSignLabs sends a document for signing through “Create and Send Document From Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create and Send Document From Template” in OpenSignLabs
bestTemplate.why: It sends a ready document from a template to its signers the moment an order is cancelled.

watchOut: “Create and Send Document From Template” sends to signers outside the business, so it waits for your approval first.
